reading_rule: a stopped gamed control is weaker than a finished one. Its coverage of the fixed-point front is therefore a lower bound on what tuning on the test split achieves, and no claim that the fixed point matches or beats the gamed control is drawn from it. The gamed control at level 9 is reported as not reaching a fixed point within the budget (UNMEASURED fixed point).
